note: deep-review C20: a dispatch method whose branches each end in a single update_prop and whose terminal else is assert(false). In-range selectors update one field; an out-of-range selector matches NO branch and MUST abort on-chain (the re-emitted assert(cond0||cond1)), not produce a spendable no-op state continuation. The post-state ANF interpreter is permissive (skips asserts) so it silently builds a no-op continuation; only the real Bitcoin Script rejects — hence cryptoNearMiss on the reject.
